identification: Donald Friend (1915-1989), '3 Nudes', Bali period (he lived in Bali from 1968 to 1980), undated. Three standing nude male youths, adolescent in appearance: two at left facing each other in profile, one at right facing front with a hand raised to the shoulder. Pen and black ink with dense hatching, ochre and orange watercolour wash, opaque white gouache highlights, pale blue-grey gouache ground and a pinkish-buff floor band, on paper. Catalogue size 73 x 48 cm. The photo geometry fits that being the sight size, with the frame about 96 x 71 cm, but it is not confirmed. Gold reeded frame, double mat (beige outer, grey inner), glazed. Condition from photos: a few grey-brown spots lower centre and fine specks lower right (possible foxing or mould); no tears or creases visible; fading cannot be judged. No bid yet on 28 Nov 2026 (opens at $1,000).

viewing_check: Measure the sheet (sight size). 73 x 48 should be the image, not the frame.

Back of the frame: gallery label (Holdsworth, Schubert, Australian Galleries, Christopher Day, Von Bertouch) or old auction lot number. A label lifts it and settles authenticity; a bare back means the selling house will vet it harder.
Under the glass: foxing or mould (the grey spots lower centre), fading of the ochre wash, cockling, mat burn, and whether the sheet is laid down on board.
